sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities. The Qwen3 series includes models of both dense and Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) architectures, with parameter scales ranging from 0.6 to 235 billion. A key innovation in Qwen3 is the ...

sources.title: Reward Hacking Mitigation using Verifiable Composite Rewards
sources.snippet: Our experiments show that extending RLVR with our proposed reward model leads to better-formatted reasoning with less reward hacking and good accuracy compared to the baselines. This approach marks a step toward reducing reward hacking and enhancing the reliability of models utilizing RLVR 1.

sources.title: Qwen: Qwen3.5-9B - AI Model Details & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B, a multimodal foundation model from qwen, demonstrates a strong overall reliability with an 83% success rate across benchmarks, indicating consistent operational stability. However, its speed performance is a notable area for improvement, ranking in the 10th percentile, suggesting longer response times compared to peers.
